Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Black Duck (formerly Synopsys Software Integrity Group) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Black Duck that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.

Fuji Xerox and FUJIFILM Business Innovation products such as multifunction devices, printers, production printers, software, and cloud services.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.

EasyVista - EV Service Manager; EV Service Apps; EV Self Help; EV Observe; EV Digital Experience Monitoring; EV Reach; and EV Discovery.
